segments.an9.10:1.1: “Navayime, bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
segments.an9.10:1.3: Arahā, arahattāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī, anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī, sakadāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sotāpanno, sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, gotrabhū – ime kho, bhikkhave, nava puggalā āhuneyyā … pe … anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassā”ti.
segments.an9.10:2.1: Sambodhi nissayo ceva, meghiya nandakaṃ balaṃ;
segments.an9.10:2.3: Sevanā sutavā sajjho, puggalo āhuneyyena cāti.
